name: MicroFounder

sources.title: Homepage — curated directory of solo/near-solo founders' startups showing MRR figures
Join page — 'Join MicroFounder $199 $99 one-time payment'; membership includes startup profile

requirements: Positioned for solo and near-solo founders (microfounders) building 'real internet businesses' — curated, not open
Listing is gated behind membership: 'Join MicroFounder' is a $99 one-time payment (marked down from $199)
Startup profiles display public MRR figures — be prepared to share revenue
preparation: Startup name, URL, description, and logo
Revenue/MRR figure you are willing to display publicly (listings show e.g. '$10k/mo')
Founder profile details — members get listed in a founders directory too
workflow: Open https://microfounder.com/join and pay the $99 one-time membership
Log in and create the startup profile (name, URL, description, MRR)
Profile appears in the Startups directory, founders list, and 'New members' section
watchFor: No free submission route found — this is a paid community/listing hybrid
Public revenue display is the site's signature — skip if you don't want MRR shown
Curated positioning — membership may still be reviewed despite payment
No self-serve free 'submit' endpoint anywhere on the site
countsAsLive: The startup gets a public page under microfounder.com/startups/<slug> and the founder appears in the members/founders lists
unknowns: Whether membership can be rejected/refunded after payment
Whether free-tier listing ever existed (pricing may change)
